updated_blocks.markdown: **CORRECTION — integration certificates withdrawn pending safe replay.** An adversarial test found that sparse interval-polynomial cleanup can discard a nonzero-width Arb coefficient containing zero. The point integration and center-escape certificates previously summarized here are unverified until replayed with corrected arithmetic; existing PASS receipts and agreement between implementations do not repair their shared defect. Actual uniform-field arithmetic was observed dropping uncertain coefficients. Exact-rational moment formulas, the older dense-matrix quadrature-root/minimum proofs, and root-independent exact geometry certificates are unaffected by this defect. No exact-integral root or novelty is established. The original five-gate objective remains incomplete.

Confirmed reproduction: for a nonzero-width Arb ball containing zero, both `v == 0` and `v != 0` can be false. The frozen helper used `if v != 0`, which can discard an uncertain coefficient. The new uniform element-0 construction discarded ten uncertain coefficients. Two tested point-series stages showed no observed drops, but that limited check does not validate the complete older point runs.

The earlier integration figures and numerical center-escape conclusion are retained as historical, provisional material and are WITHDRAWN pending a complete corrected replay. The old quadrature model certificates and exact geometry results use different arithmetic and remain valid within their original scopes. A numerical center selected from an unverified correction remains a proposal; geometry of its explicitly supplied boxes can still be proved independently of any root or correction accuracy.

Audit: evidence/interval_polynomial_cleanup_audit.json, SHA256 fe0f5414ecf16b6ff3e804d53a6ad68d44ef6a6766824786acd4ef2645fff084. A versioned safe polynomial kernel, adversarial zero-crossing guards, corrected producer and independent replays, and fresh documentation verification are required before restoring the integration claims.
